page.overview:
Who is Payton Warden?

The Payton Warden, is a minor character in Invincible, debuting in Season 3. She is the warden of Payton Penitentiary.

The Payton Warden has an average height and a balanced build with a medium brown complexion. Her hair is dark with a gray stripe and is pulled back into a neat low style. Her eyes are dark brown in color and her lips are red.

She is dressed in a dark suit jacket paired with matching dark suit pants and shoes of the same color that create a consistent and professional look. Under the jacket, she wears a white blouse.

While her personality isn't deeply explored due to her minor status, her position as a warden suggests a stern, no-nonsense demeanor necessary to manage a penitentiary for super-criminals.
